N-simon.objects: Three Banach spaces X,B,Y and an Lp(X) family F are named.
N-simon.domain: A fixed finite T>0 and all 1<=p<=infinity are explicit; no spatial dimension is presupposed.
N-simon.fixed_and_variable: The embeddings and T are fixed; trajectories vary in F, and only a subsequence is concluded.
N-simon.hypotheses: X->B is compact, B->Y continuous, with one uniform spatial bound and one family-uniform translation modulus.
N-simon.equations: Both the Lp(X) bound and Lp(0,T-h;Y) limit are displayed.
N-simon.quantifiers: The supremum over every f in F is inside the h-down-to-zero limit; constants do not depend on f.
N-simon.conclusion: Strong Lp(B) precompactness for finite p, and compact continuous representatives for p=infinity.
N-simon.status: Established imported theorem from the verified journal text; not an original result.
N-simon.local_definitions: Compact injection and shortened translation domain are stated; standard Bochner spaces are refreshed locally.
